title: Pluralized right label
description: Right header label changes from "Próxima salida" to "Próximas salidas" — the board always lists several upcoming departures at once, so the plural more accurately describes what the column shows. Left label ("Destino") is unchanged. Recommended.

changes.intent: Match the label to the actual content: a list of multiple upcoming departures, not a single one.
changes.detail: Change the static text of the second header span from "Próxima salida" to "Próximas salidas". No structural or style change.
